pp_fit.feature: Authorization receipts for financial commitment agents
pp_fit.value_prop: Every PO Lio executes on behalf of an enterprise is an autonomous financial commitment. PP provides tamper-proof receipts proving which agent took which action, under whose authority, with what budget approval — turning Lio's output from 'AI did it' into a fully auditable procurement chain.
pp_fit.urgency: very high — announced $30M Series A TODAY from a16z; actively hiring engineering; expansion to US market; precisely the moment to get PP baked into their agent architecture before it hardens
pp_fit.pitch_angle: Your agents manage billions. When the CFO asks 'who approved that $2M contract?' — Lio needs the answer to be provable, not reconstructed. PP is the audit layer your enterprise clients will demand once Lio becomes mission-critical.

score_breakdown.notes: Highest timing score possible — funding announced same day as this research run. a16z backing validates market, US expansion = sales pressure to close enterprise logos fast.
